compatibility_note: Only publicly readable data may be transmitted. Declarations are assignments, not actual focus. Leaving combat does not guarantee readable NPC names or unlocked chat. The unrelated restriction-event false block is fixed; all follower-dungeon restrictions are not claimed fixed. A manually pressed native /p macro is a separate game path, not an exemption for addon SendChatMessage or secret serialization.
